semiconductor_relevance: High — Agnisys Technology specializes in advanced design automation tools and IP solutions for semiconductor design, particularly in the areas of functional specification and interconnect IP generation.
summary: Agnisys Technology Pvt. Ltd develops innovative EDA tools that leverage agentic AI to streamline the semiconductor design process from specification to RTL sign-off. Their solutions include a scalable Network-on-Chip (NoC) interconnect IP generation tool, enhancing design efficiency and integration for multi-core SoCs.
